pages.text: The place where we first arrived seems better remembered by the world. I tried leaving that memory elsewhere.$(br2)Place the anchor beside a supplied reservoir and $(l)use it with an empty hand to wake it$(). With aether flowing, this land keeps working beyond your sight.

pages.title: Sleep and Waking
pages.text: At first it watches its own chunk. Sneak-use the tuner to spread its memory over the surrounding nine.$(br2)An empty reserve, or the world’s long sleep, lets the mark fall quiet. $(l)Return to it$() and let the land recognize your footsteps again.
